decisions.reason: Retaining the I2C 0 Ω series resistors does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, or pin-order policy.
The decision concerns retaining existing I2C series resistors and does not alter any component sourceability or connector sourcing policy.
The I2C series-resistor decision is unrelated to the battery connector's series, pitch, pins, functions, or mounting type.
Retaining I2C series resistors does not affect battery connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
The referenced 0 Ω parts are I2C series resistors, not the switched rail's MT3608 enable pull-down or any other rail setting.
